Interactive Ball Duel – Product Overview

Product Number: LJST030

Interactive Ball Duel is a team-based competitive experience designed to bring people together through fast-paced physical challenges. In this multiplayer activity, two teams go head-to-head in exciting matches that test coordination, strategy, and group dynamics. Ideal for corporate team building or group entertainment, this engaging game helps strengthen collaboration, sharpen reflexes, and encourage quick decision-making in a lively setting.

Category Details
Product Number LJST030
Space Required 5m (L) × 4m (W) × 3m (H)
Number of Players 4 – 6 participants
Duration per Session 3 – 5 minutes
Power Consumption 125W


Key Features

Team-Based Competitive Play
Participants compete in energetic duels that challenge both individual skills and collective teamwork.


Physical Coordination & Strategy
The game promotes agility, fast thinking, and clear communication among teammates to achieve shared goals.


Fast-Paced Match Format
Each round demands focus, cooperation, and the ability to adapt quickly to changing situations.


Real-Time Performance Feedback
An instant scoring system tracks results, offering clear insights into team performance and individual contributions.


Accessible and Engaging for All Ages
Designed to accommodate various skill levels, the activity is well-suited for diverse participant groups.


Sturdy, Long-Lasting Equipment
Constructed with durable materials to withstand frequent use during high-energy gameplay.


Flexible Game Settings
Difficulty levels and match formats can be adjusted to match group preferences, ensuring a fresh experience each time.



Advantages & Applications

Corporate Team Building
Creates a fun and interactive setting where colleagues can develop trust, improve communication, and strengthen collaboration.


Enhances Coordination Under Pressure
Helps players improve physical coordination, reaction time, and decision-making in dynamic situations.


Encourages Friendly Competition
Offers an enjoyable way to engage in spirited competition while reinforcing the value of teamwork.


Adapts to Different Group Sizes
Suitable for both small teams and larger group events, providing flexibility for various occasions.


Great for Entertainment Venues
An excellent addition to amusement parks, arcades, and family entertainment centers seeking interactive group attractions.


Fun for a Wide Age Range
Appeals to both children and adults, making it a popular choice for family-friendly activities.
